design: noise trauma by time of day
finding_paraphrased: Night noise causes permanent threshold shifts whereas day-exposed mice recover; cochlear clock is self-sustained (PER2::LUC, mainly auditory neurons and hair cells); BDNF higher after day noise; a TrkB agonist at night protects

design: SCN ablation; adrenalectomy; day vs night noise; dexamethasone timing
finding_paraphrased: Cochlear rhythms are system-driven; adrenalectomy leaves core clock genes but abolishes inflammatory clock-controlled genes and the day/night difference in noise sensitivity; dexamethasone protects only when given in the day
